subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as plugin-owned opt-in buffers for affected channels, a generic channel SDK/gateway media coalescer, or deferred to narrow channel bugs only?
rationale: The remaining work changes public config, turn boundaries, latency, retry/lifecycle behavior, and channel ownership, so automation should not choose the product/API boundary on its own.

options.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
options.body: Implement sender/conversation-scoped media buffers in affected channel plugins first, adding shared SDK helpers only when duplication becomes concrete.

options.title: Generic SDK/gateway coalescer
options.body: Design a broader typed media coalescing contract before implementation, accepting a larger compatibility and ownership review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep text debounce plus Telegram album handling as the supported behavior and fix only narrower channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
recommendation.body: Implement sender/conversation-scoped media buffers in affected channel plugins first, adding shared SDK helpers only when duplication becomes concrete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared debounce policy, plugin boundaries, and config compatibility surfaces this person recently touched.
